roms.title: Overflow Family Matrix
roms.desc: Eighteen cells compare signed and unsigned add, subtract, and multiply at three widths. Each bar divides clean results from overflow results as all cases run together.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: By-Value Boundary Trio
roms.desc: Three record shapes travel through mutating function calls. Their output traces move while the caller's original records remain steady, checking value-copy semantics across the four-to-five-byte ABI boundary.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Sparse Switch Ladder
roms.desc: Sixteen widely separated case values form an uneven ladder. A sparse comparison-tree dispatcher and a compact dispatcher draw overlapping traces of the same computation.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Jump-Table Boundary Sweep
roms.desc: Three virtual machines run through switches with 127, 128, and 129 destinations. Their phase portraits overlap when both sides of the jump-table lowering boundary agree.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Nested VLA Pyramid
roms.desc: A pyramid of cells pictures two levels of runtime-sized arrays. Row lengths show the outer allocations, and cell heights show the independently sized inner allocations.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Unreachable Sentinel
roms.desc: A six-state machine traces its legal transitions around a ring. Guarded impossible edges stay dim while the reachable sequence runs beside the compiled trap paths.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Unaligned Record Reader
roms.desc: A binary stream becomes a ruler of colored records and fields. Seven-byte and ten-byte records make odd addresses and padding-free layouts visible.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Lexicographic Race
roms.desc: Twenty-four strings line up as rows of glyph blocks. Their order and highlighted deciding bytes show how strcmp, strncmp, and memcmp resolve their comparisons.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Bisection Oracle
roms.desc: Binary searches probe an eight-by-eight field of sorted keys. The narrowing search lights its candidates before showing a hit in green or a miss in red.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Precision Bridge
roms.desc: Two chaotic traces begin from the same floating-point state. One computes each step in float; the other crosses into double precision and back, revealing where their paths separate.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Affine Stage Pipeline
roms.desc: A matrix travels by value through six transformation stages. Each panel draws its transformed shape while the caller's original matrix must remain unchanged.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Reservoir Ladder
roms.desc: Twelve reservoirs exchange their contents through checked subtraction. A transfer that would underflow is rejected, and its reservoir flashes and bounces instead of draining.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Run-Length Scanline Decoder
roms.desc: A run-length image appears one scanline at a time. The gauge beside each row shows the runtime-sized temporary allocation needed to decode it.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: ISA-256 Bytecode Machine
roms.desc: A 256-opcode virtual machine draws a phase portrait as it runs. A 16-by-16 opcode map lights up the handlers, exposing the compiler's large jump-table dispatch path.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Bank/Direct-Page Windows
roms.desc: Interrupts land while the direct-page base or data-bank register points away from the C program's normal memory. Three animated regions show the windows whose state must survive the interrupt.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: IRQ Gate
roms.desc: A raster-timer interrupt meets the SNES vertical-blank interrupt. Moving lanes and counters expose the overlap while a C interrupt handler checks that nested interrupts preserve machine state.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Retry-On-Fault Ladder
roms.desc: Twenty-four attempts climb a ladder of recursive calls. Successful attempts settle in green; faults flash red and jump back to retry, checking that repeated nonlocal returns preserve their state.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Callee-Saved Restore Curve
roms.desc: Six harmonograph curves are drawn from coefficients restored after a nonlocal jump. The worker occupies the saved register slots, making the restored coefficients a direct check of longjmp.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Backtracking Solver
roms.desc: Watch an eight-queens search place queens, reject dead ends, and jump back to earlier choices. Each backjump discards real recursive call frames while restoring the saved stack and registers.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controller input required

roms.title: Software Vectors
roms.desc: Real BRK and COP software interrupts enter distinct native-mode vectors from both 8-bit and 16-bit width contexts. Signature-byte return, interrupt envelopes, and handler state feed two independently moving lanes. Compiler stress-test #140 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — BRK and COP packets traverse their own vector lanes

roms.title: Far-Pointer Order Shuffle
roms.desc: An insertion sort orders genuine 24-bit far pointers across a 64K bank boundary, then computes representable pointer differences between adjacent entries. Compiler stress-test #129 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — pointer lanes reorder across the bank boundary

roms.title: 64K Bank-Boundary Walk
roms.desc: Forward pointer increments, indexed offsets, and reverse pointer decrements read a far table across the C1:FFFF to C2:0000 seam. Compiler stress-test #128 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — two walkers cross the gold 64K bank seam

roms.title: Threaded Mode Interpreter
roms.desc: A labels-as-values bytecode interpreter alternates byte and native-word handlers across indirect control-flow joins. Its opcode tape and output bytes draw the live glyph. Compiler stress-test #127 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — A8/A16 handler lanes feed an output glyph

roms.title: Mid-Bracket NMI Tunnel
roms.desc: A 1,024-frame interrupt torture test makes NMI repeatedly cut through long native-width arithmetic sequences. Paired computations detect any corrupted return width while a moving needle crosses the A16 tunnel. Compiler stress-test #124 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — NMI needle cuts through the native-width tunnel

roms.title: Seismograph Absolute Trace
roms.desc: The C llabs function and the signed x < 0 ? -x : x idiom rectify 64-bit samples across every 16-bit limb, including INT64_MIN+1. The tested values drive a dual-trace scope. Compiler stress-test #121 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — gold signed trace and cyan rectified envelope

roms.title: 64-Bit Limb-Seam Barrel
roms.desc: Variable 64-bit left, logical-right, and arithmetic-right shifts sweep the 15/16/17 and 31/32/33 limb boundaries. Three synchronized texture bands make carry and sign fill visible. Compiler stress-test #138 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — three shift bands sweep the highlighted limb seams

roms.title: Bitboard Knight Tour
roms.desc: A 64-bit knight-move generator uses popcountll, clzll, and ctzll to select and score each move. The three i64 intrinsics lower inline and drive both the tour and its differential CRC. Compiler stress-test #120 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — gold knight, cyan reachable squares, blue visited trail

roms.title: Far-Pointer Spill Funnel
roms.desc: Ten non-rematerializable 32-bit far pointers stay live across a clobbering multiply call, forcing seven complete Imag32 stack slots and 28-byte spill/reload traffic. Compiler stress-test #131 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — pointer ribbons squeeze through registers and spill parking slots

roms.title: Motion-Detect Difference Field
roms.desc: Three synchronized motion-detector bands exercise unsigned 8-bit, signed 16-bit, and unsigned 32-bit absolute difference. The same computed values drive the visible silhouettes and the differential CRC. Compiler stress-test #119 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — three width lanes track the same drifting motion silhouette

roms.title: Inline-Asm Island
roms.desc: Native-width C arithmetic crosses an opaque inline-assembly island that changes M, clobbers A and flags, and uses explicitly encoded A8/A16 immediates. Compiler stress-test #125 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — moving scan lines cross the red assembly island

roms.title: Split-Personality Link
roms.desc: A call-ping-pong chain crossing between per-function A16 and forced-A8 code. IR and disassembly prove the feature sets differ while the shared ABI keeps every result bit-exact. Compiler stress-test #126 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — the split field visualizes calls crossing the A8/A16 boundary

roms.title: VBlank Interrupt Tally
roms.desc: A real C VBlank interrupt handler updating 16- and 32-bit counters while native-width mainline code runs. This ROM exposed and now guards the 65816 ISR width-state bug. Compiler stress-test #123 (Round 7).
roms.keys: Self-running — 120 interrupts fill the field, then the verified tally holds

roms.title: Apollo 11 Daylight Launch
roms.desc: The Saturn V climbing out of the smoke cloud on 16 mm 1969 film — the SVX2 codec's hardest realistic input, at 78.9% compression and a locked true 59.94 fps.
roms.keys: No controls — the 600-frame loop plays continuously at one frame per VBlank.

roms.title: Seam Demo — Three-Act Boundary Cartridge
roms.desc: A 48 Mbit ExHiROM cartridge that reads all six of its megabytes three different ways: a VM executing the cartridge as one bytecode stream, an adversarial pointer-graph walk touching every decode cell, and a Mode 7 flyover over a cart-spanning atlas. One instruction is split across the physical boundary between the two mask ROMs.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: SVX2 60 FPS FastROM Video
roms.desc: Twenty seconds of NASA launch imagery: two spectacular Artemis animations at 2× plus genuine 59.94p Apollo 11 footage, with zero-slip SVX2 decoding.
roms.keys: Start pause/resume · A resume · L/R frame step · ←/→ seek or hold to shuttle

roms.title: ExHiROM 64 Mbit Cartridge Test
roms.desc: An 8 MiB ExHiROM cartridge at the extended map's ceiling — including the 64 KiB that is physically present but addressable by nothing, because banks $7E/$7F are WRAM. The model reports those holes and refuses to place data in them.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: ExHiROM 48 Mbit Cartridge Test
roms.desc: A 6 MiB extended-mapping cartridge — physically 32 Mbit + 16 Mbit — that reads across the 4 MiB device boundary the ordinary SNES maps cannot reach past. The Tales of Phantasia configuration, generated from a port of the bsnes-jg cartridge bus.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: HiROM 32 Mbit Cartridge Test
roms.desc: A 4 MiB HiROM cartridge that proves its own address decoder: every decoded window, every accepted mirror, and byte runs crossing one and several 64 KiB banks, all checked against a host model of the bsnes-jg cartridge bus. Green screen = every byte landed where the model said.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Times-table Cardioid
roms.desc: 200 circle points, chords from i to (k·i) mod N — k animates 2–30 tracing cardioids, nephroids, and epicycloid envelopes. The inner loop runs __mulsi3 + __umodsi3 per chord. Compiler stress-test #27.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: TEA Cipher Avalanche
roms.desc: 32 rounds of the Tiny Encryption Algorithm paint a 16×16 tile grid; 16 key variants each differing by 1 bit demonstrate the avalanche effect live. Hot loop is pure 32-bit shift/add/XOR — no multiply. Compiler stress-test #30.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Hilbert Curve
roms.desc: An order-4 Hilbert space-filling curve traces 256 grid positions in one connected path. The d2xy kernel uses variable-count 32-bit shifts (__ashlsi3), the corner TEA #30 missed. Compiler stress-test #28.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: FFT Spectrum Analyser
roms.desc: 32-point radix-2 DIT FFT runs every frame; 16 frequency bars track a sweeping sine tone. Butterfly twiddle multiply = 320 __mulsi3 per frame. Exercises bit-reversal permutation. Compiler stress-test #25.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: VA_ARG Formatter
roms.desc: mini_sprintf() formats Lissajous HUD parameters via va_arg — the first demo to exercise the variadic calling convention on the 65816. 9 va_arg reads per gate; 6 curve pairs cycle. Compiler stress-test #32.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Barnes-Hut Galaxy
roms.desc: 8-body gravity via a recursively built-and-walked quadtree, chased through runtime child indices — the first demo to exercise pointer-chasing dynamic trees. Stars draw trails as the galaxy collapses. Compiler stress-test #31.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Function Plotter
roms.desc: A recursive-descent parser evaluates math expressions on the SNES using soft-float arithmetic — every +, *, / is a software libcall (~3 000 cycles). The parser recurses 7 levels deep per pixel, stressing the soft-stack ABI. Four curves cycle automatically. Compiler stress-test #24.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: L-System Plant
roms.desc: An L-system fractal plant grown by string rewriting — five generations of in-place memmove + memcpy + strlen over a 1 700-byte buffer, then a turtle walks the result with a bracket push/pop stack. The first demo in the battery to call the string libcalls. Bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #23.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Truchet · Packed Bitfields
roms.desc: The 10-PRINT / Truchet diagonal maze, but every cell is a 16-bit C bitfield struct (orient/style/hue/phase/mark/energy in one word). A colour wave ripples through, stressing the bitfield insert/extract codegen — and/ora/shift, no libcalls — bit-for-bit identical host vs target. Compiler stress-test #29b.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Bytecode-VM Turtle
roms.desc: A stack-machine bytecode interpreter drawing LOGO turtle graphics — its switch(op) compiles to a JMP (abs,X) jump table and its ALU ops dispatch through a function-pointer opcode table (indirect/computed control flow no other demo runs). The woven rosette is bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #29a.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Boids Flock
roms.desc: Reynolds flocking built on a vec2 struct passed and returned BY VALUE — on the 16-bit 65816 that forces the aggregate-return ABI (register pair vs sret), run O(N²) per frame. The coherent, heading-coloured flock is bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #26.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: 64-Bit Avalanche
roms.desc: A 64-bit splitmix64 hash visualised as an avalanche matrix — cell (i,j) = output bit j of hash64(seed^(1<<i)). On a 16-bit CPU every op is a multi-limb libcall (__muldi3/__udivdi3/64-bit shifts); a correct mixer gives a ~50%-dense rainbow field, bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #22.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Double-Precision Mandelbrot
roms.desc: The Mandelbrot set in 64-bit IEEE-754 double (top half) beside a 32-bit float twin (bottom half). No FPU, so every double op is a soft-float libcall (__muldf3/__adddf3/__gtdf2); the escape buffer is bit-for-bit identical to host x86 across every codegen mode. Compiler stress-test #33.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Soft-Float Mandelbrot
roms.desc: The Mandelbrot set in IEEE-754 single-precision float — on a CPU with no FPU, so every multiply, add and compare is a software-float libcall. The chunky image grinds in because each fat pixel is hundreds of __mulsf3/__addsf3; bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #21.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Burning Ship Fractal
roms.desc: The Mandelbrot’s folded cousin — z = (|Re z| + i|Im z|)² + c — rendered as escape-time colour bands with the iconic black ship silhouette. Three multiplies per iteration plus the abs fold; multiply-only. Compiler stress-test #3.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Raycaster Maze
roms.desc: A Wolfenstein-style grid raycaster: a first-person camera auto-walks a 16×16 maze, one DDA-cast ray per column with a per-column 1/distance divide. The battery’s division member — three __udivsi3 per column. Compiler stress-test #15.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Julia Set Explorer
roms.desc: A morphing Julia fractal — z² + c in Q5.10 fixed point, three 32-bit multiplies per iteration, far-stored into high WRAM and drawn through Mode 7 as c orbits a path. The affine matrix spins it while the multiply grind morphs it. Compiler stress-test #1.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Lissajous Harmonograph
roms.desc: Four damped pendulums trace a Lissajous figure that precesses and spirals inward as the exponential damping decays. Eight fixed-point multiplies per sample (sin·env + env·decay), no divide. Compiler stress-test #9.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Conway's Game of Life
roms.desc: A Gosper glider gun fires gliders into a settling random soup on a 128×112 bit-packed grid. Neighbour counts are summed bit-parallel (SWAR half-adders) — multiply-free boolean logic. Compiler stress-test #5.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Fourier Epicycles
roms.desc: A chain of rotating vectors (the Fourier series of a 5-pointed star) draws the star outline live. The many-multiply member: four 16×16→32 multiplies per harmonic, no divide. Compiler stress-test #10.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Maze Generate + Solve
roms.desc: A maze carved by recursive division then solved by A* with an indexed binary-heap priority queue. Stresses genuine recursion (soft-stack frame ABI) + a heap data structure; multiply/divide-free. Compiler stress-test #18.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Sorting Race
roms.desc: Quicksort vs heapsort vs mergesort race to sort three bar arrays in real time. The two recursive sorts stress the 65816 soft stack / frame ABI; heapsort is the iterative contrast. Compiler stress-test #17.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Doom Fire
roms.desc: The classic PSX-Doom fire effect: a 32×28 heat field rises and flickers from a max-heat source row through a 16-colour ramp. Deliberately multiply-free — stresses indexed 8-bit array sweep + a 16-bit xorshift PRNG. Compiler stress-test #7.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: CORDIC Rotator
roms.desc: sin/cos/atan computed with CORDIC — shift-and-add only, no multiply and no divide. A rotating hand sweeps a vector field while a live atan2 reads its angle back. The multiply-free compiler stress-test #12.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Buddhabrot
roms.desc: The Mandelbrot set’s ghost: random points iterated z²+c, and every escaping orbit is tallied into a 16 KiB density buffer in high WRAM via far scatter-writes. PRNG + far read-modify-write under +mos-a16. Compiler stress-test #4.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Newton's Fractal
roms.desc: Newton's method on z³−1 colours the complex plane into three basins of attraction — one per cube root of unity — shaded by convergence speed. One full complex division per tile. Compiler stress-test #2.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Bignum Factorial
roms.desc: n! computed live in base-10000 bignum arithmetic — 700 uint16 cells, schoolbook carry-mul. The growing decimal number fills 27 rows as n climbs toward 1000. Stresses __mulsi3 + __udivmodsi4. Compiler stress-test #20.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Reaction-Diffusion
roms.desc: Gray-Scott activator-inhibitor PDE growing Turing-instability worm patterns from a 2×2 seed on a 32×28 toroidal grid. 384 32-bit multiplies per frame. Compiler stress-test #8.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: N-body Orbits
roms.desc: Sun, Earth, and Jupiter orbit each other under Newtonian 1/r² gravity. Symplectic Euler integration in Q8.8 fixed-point; trails fade via CGRAM palette dimming. Compiler stress-test #13.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: 1-D Cellular Automaton
roms.desc: Rule 90 draws the Sierpinski triangle; Rule 110 is Turing-complete chaos. Each pixel row is one generation scrolling down — the screen IS the computation. Pure shift+boolean, no multiply. Compiler stress-test #6.
roms.keys: X toggle rule · Enter reset

roms.title: Double Pendulum (Chaos)
roms.desc: Two double pendulums with nearly-identical starting angles swing from a shared pivot. Their mass-2 paths trace white and cyan trails into a bitmap canvas — diverging exponentially, the visual signature of chaos. Compiler stress-test #14.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: π Spigot + Monte-Carlo
roms.desc: Two π algorithms running simultaneously on the SNES: the Rabinowitz-Wagon spigot streams decimal digits via a 76-cell carry chain (32-bit div+mod per cell), while Monte-Carlo darts accumulate in the right panel. Self-running.
roms.keys: Self-running — no controls

roms.title: Wireframe 3-D Solid
roms.desc: A spinning polyhedron (tetrahedron → cube → octahedron → icosahedron). Each frame: 3×3 rotation matrix, perspective divide, and integer Bresenham lines into a 2bpp bitmap canvas. Compiler stress-test #16.
roms.keys: ↑ ↓ spin Y · ← → spin X · Q/W dolly · X/A solid · S palette · Shift trail

roms.title: Spirograph
roms.desc: Interactive hypotrochoid curves: four curve families (hypotrochoid, epitrochoid, rose, Lissajous) bloom live into a bitmap canvas with real-time parameter control from the joypad.
roms.keys: ↑ ↓ ring · ← → wheel · Q/W pen · X/A family · Shift preset

roms.title: Space Invaders
roms.desc: The arcade classic on Super Nintendo — marching aliens, falling bombs, destructible bunkers, bonus UFO. Written in C on an OOP rendering library; boots into a self-playing attract demo.
roms.keys: ← → move · Z/X/A fire · Enter play · Shift attract

roms.title: Blossom
roms.desc: Barry Martin's Hopalong strange attractor rendered live on SNES and flown around with the joypad. Accumulates into a hit-count grid in WRAM, displayed through Mode 7 with an HDMA colour split.
roms.keys: ← ↑ ↓ → pan · Q/W zoom · X/A attractor · Shift colour

roms.title: Brainfuck Threaded-Code VM
roms.desc: A Brainfuck interpreter on the SNES dispatching each opcode with a computed goto (goto *handlers[op] → an indirect jump — the "threaded code" loop). Watch it compute HELLO WORLD one byte at a time. Compiler stress-test #38.
roms.keys: Self-running — the VM interprets Hello World on a loop

roms.title: HDR Additive Bloom
roms.desc: Six drifting lights summed per cell with saturating (overflow-checked) add — where they overlap the field blows out to white, the HDR bloom look, in 8-bit integers via __builtin_add_overflow. Compiler stress-test #44.
roms.keys: Self-running — the lights drift and blow out on their own

roms.title: IIR Resonant-Filter Scope
roms.desc: Four 2-pole IIR resonators plucked into a live oscilloscope — a recursive feedback chain (y[n] from y[n-1], y[n-2]) that, unlike a feed-forward FFT, cannot be reordered. Compiler stress-test #48.
roms.keys: Self-running — the resonators are plucked and ring on their own

roms.title: Polygon Scanline Fill (VLA)
roms.desc: A filled star tumbles and morphs its point count while an even-odd scanline fill rasterises it — the per-scanline crossing table is a C99 variable-length array (int16_t xs[nv]), a runtime-sized stack frame (alloca/VLA). Compiler stress-test #36.
roms.keys: Self-running — the star tumbles and morphs on its own

roms.title: Step-Sequencer VM (Sparse Switch)
roms.desc: A tiny register VM runs a looping bytecode song driving an 8-bar equalizer; its opcode dispatch is a sparse switch (14 non-contiguous cases) the compiler must lower to a binary-search comparison tree, not a jump table. Compiler stress-test #37.
roms.keys: Self-running — the VM plays its bytecode song on its own

roms.title: Division Clock + Odometer
roms.desc: A sweeping analog clock + rolling odometer, splitting a counter into h:m:s and base-10 digits with compile-time constant divides. A probe for magic-reciprocal strength reduction — with the measured finding that llvm-mos keeps the __udiv libcall on this soft-multiply target. Compiler stress-test #39.
roms.keys: Self-running — the clock sweeps and the odometer rolls on their own

roms.title: CRC32 Hash-Marble Texture
roms.desc: A flowing procedural field where every cell's colour is a real CRC32 (poly 0xEDB88320) of its coordinates, computed by the byte-at-a-time table algorithm with a 256-entry const look-up table in ROM. Compiler stress-test #40.
roms.keys: Self-running — the hash field flows and mutates on its own

roms.title: Free-List Pool Allocator
roms.desc: A sparking particle fountain whose 48 fixed slots are recycled through a manual singly-linked LIFO free list threaded through the slots — alloc pops the head, free pushes it back, no malloc. Compiler stress-test #41.
roms.keys: Self-running — sparks are born and die as the pool recycles slots

roms.title: Duff Dissolve
roms.desc: One image dissolves into the next in scattered bursts, each tile copied by the classic Duff's device — a switch whose case labels land in the middle of a do/while loop, forming irreducible control flow. Compiler stress-test #42.
roms.keys: Self-running — one image dissolves into the next

roms.title: Signed 64-bit Odometer
roms.desc: A vast signed odometer ticks through zero, each value split into decimal digits by the v%10 / v/=10 loop — exercising the sign-corrected 64-bit divide+modulo libcall __divmoddi4 on a CPU with no hardware divide. Compiler stress-test #43.
roms.keys: Self-running — the odometer tape ticks through zero

roms.title: Type-Pun Metaballs
roms.desc: Gooey blobs merge and split, their 1/dist glow computed by the Quake III fast inverse square root — the union{float;uint32} bit hack with magic constant 0x5f3759df. Compiler stress-test #45.
roms.keys: Self-running — the blobs merge and split on their own

roms.title: qsort Sort Visualizer
roms.desc: Bars reshuffle then re-sort under libc qsort with a rotating function-pointer comparator. Building it caught a real backend crash — an unlegalized G_SCMP three-way compare — since fixed. Compiler stress-test #46.
roms.keys: Self-running — bars reshuffle then re-sort

roms.title: Newton Reciprocal Floor
roms.desc: A scrolling perspective checkerboard floor whose 1/z depth is a multiply-only Newton-Raphson fixed-point reciprocal — no hardware divide, no divide libcall. Compiler stress-test #47.
roms.keys: Self-running — the floor scrolls toward the horizon

roms.title: LZ77 Decompress Reveal
roms.desc: A compressed diamond image loads in on-screen, decoded by an LZ77 byte-stream decoder that copies back-references from its own output buffer (sliding window, overlap = RLE). Compiler stress-test #49.
roms.keys: Self-running — the compressed image decodes and reveals

roms.title: Many-Arg Color Grade
roms.desc: A ten-coefficient color grade re-grades a gradient through looks. So many arguments that the extras spill onto the soft stack — the register-overflow calling convention. Compiler stress-test #50.
roms.keys: Self-running — the scene re-grades through looks

roms.title: Protothread Critters
roms.desc: A swarm of critters, each a resumable protothread (coroutine) that yields every frame and resumes its scripted patrol via a saved continuation index — case labels inside loops. Compiler stress-test #51.
roms.keys: Self-running — each critter runs its own patrol

roms.title: Cross-Byte Bitfields
roms.desc: A 65816 instruction decoder packs eight fields into a 32-bit word — two of them straddle byte boundaries (group crosses bit 16, flags crosses bit 24), forcing multi-byte shift and mask. Compiler stress-test #52.
roms.keys: Self-running — decoded fields colour a scrolling map

roms.title: Bit-Census Field
roms.desc: Every cell's colour is a bit-population count of its coordinates — popcount, count-leading-zeros, count-trailing-zeros, parity — cycling the four __builtin_*ll intrinsics, which inline-lower to SWAR bit-count trees. XOR fractal, magnitude bands, ruler, checker. Compiler stress-test #53.
roms.keys: Self-running — the field scrolls and the intrinsic cycles

roms.title: Funnel-Shift Kaleidoscope
roms.desc: An 8-fold kaleidoscope driven by two-source funnel shifts — fshl(A,B,k) and fshr(B,A,k) with A≠B — forcing the LLVM backend's "terrible" double-source shift+OR expansion that no prior demo triggered. Compiler stress-test #73.
roms.keys: Self-running — the mandala animates as the shift count sweeps

roms.title: Perfect-Shuffle Transition
roms.desc: An image scrambles into its bit-reversed "butterfly" order and reassembles — the perfect shuffle from the FFT — driven by __builtin_bitreverse32 (its own inverse) and __builtin_bswap32, which inline-lower on the 65816. Compiler stress-test #54.
roms.keys: Self-running — the image scrambles and reassembles

roms.title: GF(2⁸) Galois Field
roms.desc: A morphing finite-field plaid coloured by GF(2⁸) carryless multiplies — the arithmetic under Reed-Solomon and QR codes: log/antilog tables and xor, no carry chain. A live RS syndrome lights up when a symbol is corrupted. Compiler stress-test #55.
roms.keys: Self-running — the field plaid morphs, the syndrome updates

roms.title: Rotozoom
roms.desc: The demoscene spin-zoom: each cell samples a procedural texture at a Q16.16 rotated/scaled coordinate, using the widening multiply-high (keep the middle of a 64-bit product). On a chip with no multiply, it measures how that lowers. Compiler stress-test #56.
roms.keys: Self-running — the texture spins and breathes

roms.title: Median Denoiser
roms.desc: Salt-and-pepper noise cleaned by a 3x3 median filter, computed as a 19-comparator branchless min/max sorting network (no multiply, no divide). A sweeping wipe shows denoised vs raw. Compiler stress-test #57.
roms.keys: Self-running — the wipe sweeps between noisy and clean

roms.title: Domain Colouring
roms.desc: The poles of a rational complex map (z*z-1)/(z*z+c) painted on a Super Nintendo, detected with NaN / unordered floating-point comparisons (x != x). Software float, no FPU; develops a row at a time, then shimmers. Compiler stress-test #58.
roms.keys: Self-running — the field develops, then the palette shimmers

roms.title: Cosmic Zoom Ruler
roms.desc: A 64-bit scale growing through the powers of ten, swept across a logarithmic ruler by converting it to float (__floatundisf) and back (__fixunssfdi) — the 64-bit-integer-to-float conversion. Compiler stress-test #59.
roms.keys: Self-running — the bar sweeps up the powers of ten

roms.title: Multi-Base Clock
roms.desc: One counter shown in decimal, dozenal, hex and sexagesimal at once, each digit split with the standard-library div() returning a div_t (quotient+remainder) struct by value, plus a 64-bit odometer via lldiv(). Compiler stress-test #60.
roms.keys: Self-running — the same instant ticks in four bases

roms.title: Diffie-Hellman Colour-Mixer
roms.desc: Two parties agree on a shared secret colour via 64-bit modular exponentiation — the key exchange behind HTTPS. The 64-bit maths crashed the backend until this demo found and fixed the bug (patch 0017). Compiler stress-test #61.
roms.keys: Self-running — the shared secret is always agreed

roms.title: Union-Find Percolation
roms.desc: Random bonds join neighbouring cells; a wet region spreads from the top until it percolates to the bottom, tracked by a disjoint-set (union-find) with path compression — pointer-chasing that flattens the path in place. Compiler stress-test #62.
roms.keys: Self-running — the wet region spreads, then reseeds

roms.title: Fenwick Tree
roms.desc: A binary-indexed tree maintaining the running integral of a live signal, driven by the i & -i low-bit-isolation trick — hopping up and down a virtual tree of partial sums. Compiler stress-test #63.
roms.keys: Self-running — the signal moves, its integral reshapes

roms.title: Radix Sort
roms.desc: A non-comparison sort: bars re-bucketed by counting sort — histogram, prefix-sum, stable scatter — one digit at a time until they land in a clean ascending gradient. No comparisons anywhere. Compiler stress-test #64.
roms.keys: Self-running — bars re-bucket pass by pass, then reshuffle

roms.title: Convex Hull
roms.desc: A drifting point cloud wrapped by a rubber-band convex hull, recomputed each frame by gift-wrapping — built entirely from the sign of a 2-D cross product (left turn or right turn?). Compiler stress-test #65.
roms.keys: Self-running — the hull rubber-bands around the points

roms.title: Edit-Distance DP
roms.desc: The Levenshtein edit-distance table filled in and backtracked — a 2-D dynamic-programming grid with a min-of-three recurrence, drawn as a cost heat-map with the optimal alignment path traced through it. Compiler stress-test #66.
roms.keys: Self-running — the table and path cycle through word pairs

roms.title: Huffman Decode
roms.desc: A Huffman-coded image decoding in bit by bit — a bit-granular stream reader threading a prefix tree, left on a 0 and right on a 1, the classic progressive image reveal. Compiler stress-test #67.
roms.keys: Self-running — the coded image decodes in, then replays

roms.title: Perlin Noise
roms.desc: A flowing smoke/marble field coloured by fixed-point Perlin gradient noise — a permutation table, the 6t^5-15t^4+10t^3 fade polynomial, gradient dot products and lerp. Compiler stress-test #68.
roms.keys: Self-running — the noise field drifts like smoke

roms.title: Gouraud Triangle
roms.desc: A tumbling, smoothly colour-interpolated triangle drawn by barycentric edge-function rasterisation — three signed cross-product edge functions decide inside/outside and their values shade each pixel. Compiler stress-test #69.
roms.keys: Self-running — the shaded triangle tumbles

roms.title: Floyd-Steinberg Dither
roms.desc: A smooth gradient resolving into a four-level dither by Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion — each pixel's signed quantisation residual is spread to its down-right neighbours (7/16, 3/16, 5/16, 1/16). Compiler stress-test #70.
roms.keys: Self-running — the gradient resolves into dither

roms.title: Marching Squares
roms.desc: Iso-contours of a moving metaball field extracted by marching squares — a 16-case edge lookup indexed by the four corner signs, plus edge-crossing interpolation. Blobs merge and split under a traced outline. Compiler stress-test #71.
roms.keys: Self-running — blobs merge and split under a contour

roms.title: 3-D Grid Voxel Life
roms.desc: A 3-D cellular automaton in a true uint8 grid[6][6][6] array, tumbling as a depth-shaded voxel cube — every grid[z][y][x] makes the compiler generate the z*36+y*6+x stride arithmetic. Compiler stress-test #72.
roms.keys: Self-running — a 3-D automaton tumbles as a voxel cube

roms.title: Fabs Ridgeline
roms.desc: An animated terrain ridgeline driven by the tent-map iteration using __builtin_fabsf as the hot op, targeting the backend's inline sign-bit AND path (legalizeFAbs). V-notch peaks and valleys drift each frame. Compiler stress-test #80.
roms.keys: Self-running — the terrain undulates as seeds drift

roms.title: Copysign Compass
roms.desc: A rotating 16×16 quadrant vector field driven by __builtin_copysignf — the backend's G_FCOPYSIGN inline sign-bit transplant (lowerFCopySign). Sign-zero crossings swirl as the phase sweeps. Compiler stress-test #81.
roms.keys: Self-running — quadrant boundaries rotate as phase sweeps

roms.title: Fmin/Fmax Speed Cap
roms.desc: 12 particles attracted to center, velocity double-clamped by __builtin_fminf/__builtin_fmaxf (G_FMINNUM/G_FMAXNUM → libcall). NaN-quieting: a NaN-injected particle recovers via fmaxf. Compiler stress-test #82.
roms.keys: Self-running · teal=normal · orange=capped · red=NaN-recovered

roms.title: Truncation Staircase
roms.desc: Three bands compare truncate/floor/round on a scrolling ramp, built from __fixsfsi/__floatsisf (G_FPTOSI/G_SITOFP) since floorf/ceilf/truncf are unsupported. Compiler stress-test #83.
roms.keys: Self-running · trunc / floor / round diverge on negatives

roms.title: Montgomery Orbit
roms.desc: A multiplicative-group star polygon computed with Montgomery REDC modular multiplication — a·b mod N with no divide (multiply + shift + mask + conditional subtract). Compiler stress-test #84.
roms.keys: Self-running · division-free modmul star polygon

roms.title: Ulam Prime Sieve
roms.desc: A Sieve of Eratosthenes in a packed bit-array (arr[i>>3] |= 1u<<(i&7), runtime-variable shifts) rendered as an Ulam spiral — primes cluster on diagonals. Compiler stress-test #85.
roms.keys: Self-running · Ulam spiral of primes revealing outward

roms.title: Range Coder
roms.desc: A binary arithmetic (range) coder — interval split by a 32-bit multiply, byte-wise renormalization carry loop, adaptive probability. The primitive behind LZMA/CABAC. Compiler stress-test #86.
roms.keys: Self-running · range bar + emitted-byte waterfall

roms.title: Sobelscope
roms.desc: A signed 3×3 Sobel edge detector — signed multiply-accumulate gradients with a saturating magnitude (G_SADDSAT/G_USUBSAT). Live edge-detected animated field. Compiler stress-test #87.
roms.keys: Self-running · brighter = stronger detected edges

roms.title: DCT Bloom
roms.desc: An 8×8 integer Discrete Cosine Transform — dense int32 multiply-accumulate with a signed fixed-point descale, shown as a source block beside its coefficient heat grid. Compiler stress-test #88.
roms.keys: Self-running · source block + DCT coefficient heat grid

roms.title: ADPCM Waverider
roms.desc: An IMA-ADPCM audio decoder — a saturating predictor (G_SADDSAT/G_SSUBSAT) in a serial feedback loop with a step-size LUT walk, drawn as a scrolling oscilloscope. Compiler stress-test #89.
roms.keys: Self-running · decoded ADPCM waveform on a scope

roms.title: Scope-Guard Ripple Tank
roms.desc: A fixed-point ripple tank whose compiler stress is __attribute__((cleanup)) — synthesized scope-exit calls fanned out to every control-flow exit in reverse order. Compiler stress-test #90.
roms.keys: Self-running · ripples spread; HUD shows cleanup count

roms.title: Matrix Cascade
roms.desc: A spinning wireframe lattice driven by chained by-value 2x2 matrix multiplies — the sret hidden-pointer struct-return ABI (mat2 is 8 bytes, over the register-return threshold). Compiler stress-test #91.
roms.keys: Self-running · wireframe lattice tumbles under matrix transforms

roms.title: PlyOracle
roms.desc: A negamax + alpha-beta tic-tac-toe AI playing itself — the negate-on-return recursion (G_SUB 0,x) with a running G_SMAX and alpha-beta cutoffs. Compiler stress-test #92.
roms.keys: Self-running · AI self-play; HUD tallies X/O/draw

roms.title: Signed Multiply-Overflow Orbit
roms.desc: Six orbiters trace paths on the canvas; when a signed 16-bit multiply overflows, the orbiter teleports to the mirror quadrant and sparks orange. Uses __builtin_mul_overflow to exercise G_SMULO (signed multiply-overflow lowerMulo). Compiler stress-test #76.
roms.keys: Self-running — trails build up and sparks fire on overflow

roms.title: Saturating Comet Trails
roms.desc: Six comets leave glowing trails that saturate to white where they cross, then fade cleanly to black — no wrap-around. Uses __builtin_elementwise_add_sat/sub_sat on uint8 and int16 to exercise all four saturating-arithmetic nodes. Compiler stress-test #75.
roms.keys: Self-running — comets streak and cross, saturating to white

roms.title: Rotate-Register Kaleidoscope
roms.desc: An 8-fold mandala driven by circular bit rotations: eight ring registers rotate at different constant speeds (__builtin_rotateleft8/right8), while a 16-bit outer word rotates by a runtime amount. Exercises G_ROTL/G_ROTR ConstantAmt path and S8 special case. Compiler stress-test #74.
roms.keys: Self-running — ring registers precess producing counter-rotating petals

roms.title: Saturating-Cast Kaleidoscope
roms.desc: A 6-fold hex kaleidoscope where tile colours are float intensities clamped to int16 via fminf/fmaxf and truncated. Exercises G_FMINNUM + G_FMAXNUM + G_FPTOSI with legalizer-inserted NaN guard. Compiler stress-test #77.
roms.keys: Self-running — saturation boundary pulses as phase sweeps

roms.title: Signed-Bitfield Terrain
roms.desc: An animated eroding terrain where each cell packs int16_t height:5/slope:4/flow:4 signed fields. Reading them fires G_SEXT_INREG (sign-extend in register). Indigo valleys prove the sign-extension lowering is correct. Compiler stress-test #78.
roms.keys: Self-running — ridges erode and valleys fill each frame

roms.title: Memmove Scroll Slabs
roms.desc: Two counter-scrolling slab bands driven by overlapping memmove calls. Upper band uses memmove(dst+1,dst,N) where dst>src (descending path); lower band uses the ascending path. Both G_MEMMOVE sub-paths exercised. Compiler stress-test #79.
roms.keys: Self-running — upper band scrolls down, lower scrolls up

roms.title: Borrow-Ladder Odometer
roms.desc: A 128-bit number counting down through a limb-by-limb borrow chain, borrows rippling upward like an odometer. Exercises native-width multi-precision subtraction. Compiler stress-test #110 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — a 128-bit binary counter ticks down

roms.title: 64-bit Multiply-Overflow
roms.desc: Six orbiters carry a 64-bit momentum scaled until it overflows, then teleport and spark. The first demo to form an s64 multiply-high / multiply-overflow (G_UMULH/G_UMULO) — the one untested s64 lowering path, composed from 32-bit pieces without widening to 128 bits. Compiler stress-test #101 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — orbiters spark on 64-bit overflow

roms.title: 256-bit Modular Exponentiation
roms.desc: A 256-bit Diffie-Hellman key exchange built from 32-bit limbs and 64-bit multiply-accumulate. Hammers the 64-bit (un)merge glue that once crashed the backend, hundreds of times over. Compiler stress-test #104 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the 256-bit shared secret as a colour field

roms.title: Pressure-Cooker Fixed-Point Evaluator
roms.desc: A per-pixel fixed-point expression whose comparison flag is decided early but used only after a storm of multiplies and divides. Re-runs a register-scavenger fix for a flag held live across calls under a jammed register file. Compiler stress-test #109 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — an implicit surface with a level-set boundary

roms.title: Odd-Width Mask Sculptor
roms.desc: Values masked to odd widths — 20, 24, 28 bits — zero-extended to 64 bits and multiplied. Re-runs the odd-width extend and 64-bit split that once crashed the 16-bit-accumulator backend. Compiler stress-test #103 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — four mask-width bands terrace and flow

roms.title: 64-bit Multi-Key Record Sort
roms.desc: Records sorted by a primary 64-bit key then a secondary tie-break — two 64-bit three-way compares per comparison. The widest, densest form of the spaceship-operator fix, stacked two deep in qsort. Compiler stress-test #100 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — rows resort under a two-level 64-bit key

roms.title: Three-Way Merge Diff
roms.desc: A merge of sorted streams where the three-way compare (a>b)-(a<b) selects the branch — advance-left, advance-right, or emit-both. Uses the spaceship result as control flow, not a sort key, confirming the fix holds whatever reads its output. Compiler stress-test #99 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — teal/orange/gold braid the merge branches

roms.title: Unsigned Rank Percentile Field
roms.desc: A field recoloured by each cell's unsigned rank, computed with the three-way compare (a>b)-(a<b) at uint16/uint32/uint64. Re-runs the unsigned half of the spaceship-operator fix — the 64-bit unsigned compare the signed sort never emitted. Compiler stress-test #98 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the field recolours by unsigned rank

roms.title: Gap-Buffer Rope Editor
roms.desc: A text gap buffer whose cursor moves memmove text across the gap — both directions, past the 256-byte boundary. Re-runs the +mos-xy16 index-width fix at scale, as a real editor primitive rather than a synthetic loop. Compiler stress-test #96 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — text blocks slide across the gap

roms.title: Gather-Scatter Permutation
roms.desc: A 576-cell grid shuffled by a bijective scatter dst[perm[i]]=src[i] — two 16-bit indices live at once, a data-dependent scatter index lowering to sta abs,X. Re-runs the +mos-xy16 index-width fix on its sharpest addressing form. Compiler stress-test #95 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the grid shuffles kaleidoscopically

roms.title: In-Place Block Rotate
roms.desc: A 384-entry barber-pole buffer rotated in place by the three-reversal trick — 16-bit-indexed swaps sweeping across the register-width boundary. Re-runs the +mos-xy16 index-width fix a second way, with no memmove library call, so both angles onto the same bug are guarded. Compiler stress-test #94 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the barber-pole marquee rotates in place

roms.title: Overlap-Move Mosaic
roms.desc: A 384-byte mosaic scrolled in place by four overlapping memmoves per step — both copy directions, each over a 16-bit-indexed buffer. Re-runs the exact scenario a real +mos-xy16 in-place-memmove bug once corrupted, larger and both ways, and confirms the fix holds. Compiler stress-test #93 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the mosaic shears down-right, then up-left

roms.title: Width-Sweep Sort Gallery
roms.desc: Four bar panels sort in lockstep, each driven by the C spaceship comparator (a>b)-(a<b) at a different key width — 8/16/32/64-bit. Re-runs the fix that taught the 65816 to lower the three-way-compare (G_SCMP), now at the 32- and 64-bit widths the original never reached. Compiler stress-test #97 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — four panels sort, reshuffle, and sort again

roms.title: Bit-Banged UART Eye
roms.desc: A software UART bit-banged through carry-rotated transmit and receive registers, drawn as an oscilloscope eye diagram. Re-runs a default-build register-coalescer bug in loop-carried rotate code. Compiler stress-test #108 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — a serial eye diagram, rails and crossings shimmer

roms.title: Serial Bit-Reversal Weave
roms.desc: Bit reversal done one bit at a time through a rotate-carry loop — a loop-carried result rotated on every back edge, deliberately not the bit-reverse builtin. Re-runs a default-build register-coalescer bug in loop-carried rotate code. Compiler stress-test #107 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — a gradient shown through its bit-reversed order

roms.title: Dual-LFSR Scrambler
roms.desc: A Galois and a Fibonacci LFSR stepped together — two loop-carried shift registers folded through rotates at once. Re-runs a default-build register-coalescer bug in loop-carried rotate code, under double pressure. Compiler stress-test #106 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — two interleaved pseudo-noise fields scroll

roms.title: Bit-Serial CRC Wall
roms.desc: Three CRC checksums (8/16/32-bit) computed bit-by-bit as software shift-registers, interleaved under heavy register pressure — re-running a fix for a default-8-bit register-allocator bug that once stranded a loop-carried CRC byte. A flowing hash marble. Compiler stress-test #105 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — a bit-serial CRC hash marble flows

roms.title: 6502 CPU Simulator
roms.desc: A 6502/65C02 processor emulated on the SNES: a scrolling disassembly listing steps through a program one instruction at a time while the matching ALU logic gate lights up. The emulator’s 256-entry opcode switch is lowered to a jump table on the 65816. Compiler stress-test #102 (Round 6).
roms.keys: Self-running — the disassembly scrolls, ALU gates light up

roms.title: Mode 7 Mandelbrot (OOP)
roms.desc: The same fixed-point Mandelbrot, rebuilt through the snesgfx object-oriented C interface (Mode 7 as a polymorphic Drawable) instead of procedural calls — a formal verification client proving the OOP pattern costs nothing on real hardware.
roms.keys: Self-running — animated build, coarse-to-fine reveal, then Mode 7 spin and zoom

roms.title: Mode 7 Mandelbrot
roms.desc: A fixed-point Mandelbrot computed live on the 65816 and revealed through Mode 7 — every pixel round-trips through a 24-bit far pointer into high WRAM, the broadest single codegen exercise the publish gate runs. The canonical #321 tester.
roms.keys: Self-running — reveals coarse-to-fine, then spins and zooms

roms.title: LZSS Mode 7 Gallery
roms.desc: A complete LZSS compressor/decompressor benchmark on the 65816. 62 public-domain artworks use full-composition, aspect-preserving Mode 7 rasters with up to 219 artwork colors, then recompress and verify byte-for-byte on-console. Tap the left or right half on phones. Compiler stress-test #119.
roms.keys: Self-running — progress is measured work; D/C/V report stage frames
